key: mongodb|senior product manager technical services engineering
title: Senior Product Manager, Technical Services Engineering
hiring_location: Austin, New York City, Palo Alto, Seattle
jd_excerpt:
The CIO’s Post Sales organization builds and operates many of the technology platforms that enable the end-to-end customer lifecycle, spanning Revenue Operations, Technical Support, Customer Success, and Professional Services.
 As a Senior Product Manager within the Post Sales organization, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for the Technical Services platforms and tools. These platforms and tools are used by customer facing developers and engineers , and they directly affect how effectively these teams solve highly complex technical problems every day. Initiatives could include work around a Customer Health Application, utilizing agentic capabilities to minimize manual tasks, optimizing integration options and more.
 You will partner with Technical Services and Engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize investments, solve hard problems creatively by delivering scalable solutions that improve end customer experiences, drive operational efficiency, and support scaling business growth.
 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Austin, Seattle, Palo Alto and New York for our hybrid working model.
 Responsibilities
 Domain Expertise
 Proven experience modernizing Technical Support platforms including developer tooling, including but not limited to knowledge sharing, workforce planning, workflow automation and optimization for technical support engineers 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end support user journey, including case creation and management, omni-channel case routing, prioritization, system integrations, and AI-driven proactive customer engagement
 Expertise in customer and support agent journeys, support processes, and operational workflows, with a track record of large-scale digital transformations and delivering custom solutions that address complex business challenges creatively
 Extensive knowledge of integration patterns across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, external support portals, developer tooling and analytics platforms to deliver seamless customer and agent experiences
 Broad understanding of the post-sales milestones spanning Professional Services, Technical Support, and Solution Architects with the ability to design solutions that optimize this end user experience
 Expertise in building and scaling out of the box technology solutions for Technical Support, and Professional Services organizations
 Product Strategy & Vision
 Translate business strategy, stakeholder needs, and operational priorities into scalable, platform-based product capabilities on a product roadmap
 Partner with business and engineering leaders to provide sound judgement product investments with enterprise architecture, security, governance, and platform standards
 Develop clear product requirements (PRDs), prioritize features, define measurable outcomes, and drive adoption through data-driven decision making
 Balance short-term business priorities with long-term platform strategy to maximize customer value, operational efficiency, and business impact
 Champion a product-led mindset by continuously incorporating stakeholder feedback, operational insights, and market trends into product evolution
 Stakeholder Engagement
 Partner with Technical Services and Post Sales leaders to identify opportunities and improve how the organization works
 Represent the voice of the user, ensuring solutions address real operational challenges
 Communicate priorities, trade-offs, timelines, and progress clearly to stakeholders and leadership
 Build strong partnerships with engineering teams, architects, and external vendors
 Roadmap & Delivery
 Own and maintain the product backlog and roadmap, prioritizing work based on business impact and technical feasibility
 Work closely with engineering in an Agile environment to plan and deliver product releases
 Balance new feature development with platform improvements and addressing technical debt
 Manage cross-team dependencies and align stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery
 Adoption & Change Management
 Partner with enablement and change management teams to drive adoption of new capabilities
 Communicate product changes, new features and collaborate with the Communications team to develop messaging for customers and partners when appropriate
 Monitor KPIs and support incident or problem management when issues arise
 Requirements
 8+ years of Product Management experience in enterprise SaaS or cloud platforms
 Proven experience modernizing Technical Support and Customer platforms and developer tooling, including knowledge sharing, workforce planning, and workflow automation for support engineers
 Strong understanding of the end-to-end support journey: case creation and management, omni-channel routing, prioritization, system integrations, and AI-driven proactive engagement
 Deep knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud, and integration patterns across support portals, developer tooling, and analytics platforms
 Understanding of post-sales milestones across Professional Services, Technical Support, and Solution Architects, with the ability to design solutions that improve the end-user experience
 Experience building custom workflow applications, automation platforms, or AI-powered tools, including building and deploying agents for developer and technical support workflows
 Experience with telemetry, analytics, and customer health data, and using product metrics to guide decisions
 Track record leading large-scale digital transformations and delivering creative solutions to complex business challenges
 Ability to partner effectively with engineering, operations, and business stakeholders
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

 About MongoDB
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!
